claim: On 2023-08-10 Network Load Balancers added security groups, which you associate with the load balancer at creation; before this release, administrators managed access to applications by adding security group rules at the instance level.

values.display: associate security groups with your Network Load Balancers
security group rules at the instance level

evidence.quote: | [Security groups for your Network Load Balancer](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/elasticloadbalancing/latest/network/load-balancer-security-groups.html) | This release adds support to associate security groups with your Network Load Balancers at creation. | August 10, 2023 |
evidence.title: Document history for Network Load Balancers
